ALTER TABLE teacher_decision
    ADD COLUMN pedagogy_method VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy',
    ADD COLUMN pedagogy_method_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy-v1',
    ADD COLUMN pedagogy_stage VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unspecified',
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_decision_pedagogy_method_nonempty CHECK (btrim(pedagogy_method) <> ''),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_decision_pedagogy_method_version_nonempty CHECK (btrim(pedagogy_method_version) <> ''),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_decision_pedagogy_stage_nonempty CHECK (btrim(pedagogy_stage) <> '');
